title: Prescribed localized bases persist on a smaller principal open
statement: theorem exists_prescribed_basis_away_mul {A : Type u} [CommRing A] {M : Type v} [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] {ι : Type*} (a t : A) (m : ι → M) (b : Module.Basis ι (Localization.Away a) (LocalizedModule.Away a M)) (hb : ∀ i, b i = LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap (Submonoid.powers a) M (m i)) : ∃ b' : Module.Basis ι (Localization.Away (a * t)) (LocalizedModule.Away (a * t) M), ∀ i, b' i = LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap (Submonoid.powers (a * t)) M (m i)

source.place: Section 10.9, localization of modules, applied in the common-shrink paragraph of Tag 07C6

proof.text: Give A[1/(a*t)] its A[1/a]-algebra structure via awayToAwayRight, and verify the scalar tower on elements of A.

Base change the prescribed basis. Combine LocalizedModule.equivTensorProduct, LinearEquiv.baseChange, and TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange to identify the new module with LocalizedModule.Away (a*t) M.

Check each basis vector using the tensor-product formulas: m i divided by one maps to m i divided by one. This proves the full prescribed-vector assertion without any freeness cancellation or finiteness hypothesis.
